title: PoseLine
description: One line of poses.jsonl in a capture bundle, schema_version 1 (docs/capture-bundle.md): one line per frame, written by the Swift capture module. Checked by the validator, not by this schema: frame and t only increase, the line count matches manifest.frame_count and the keyframe lines match manifest.keyframe_count.

transform.description: ARKit's camera.transform at this frame. A snapshot: it can jump when ARKit closes a loop and is not corrected afterwards (see refined_keyframes.jsonl).

intrinsics.description: [fx, fy, cx, cy] in pixels, for an image of manifest.image_size.

tracking.description: ARKit's tracking state: normal, notAvailable, or limited:<reason> with ARKit's reason, for example limited:excessiveMotion. Processing drops limited frames.

keyframe.description: Whether this frame is a keyframe, with a JPEG, a depth PNG and a privacy/blur.jsonl line.
